O.content: The title reads "Additional Promotion Weeks: Ad Spend vs Sales".
Five blue points are visibly labeled Week 7, Week 8, Week 9, Week 10, and Week 11.

The horizontal axis is inscribed "Advertising Spend ($ thousands)" and the vertical axis is inscribed "Sales ($ thousands)"; from Week 7 through Week 11, each successive labeled point is positioned farther right and higher than the preceding one.

B.text: If the horizontal axis labeled "Advertising Spend ($ thousands)" and vertical axis labeled "Sales ($ thousands)" encode each point's respective values, then points farther right and higher represent greater advertising spend and greater sales; week labels identify the associated points.
B.conditions: Assumes the labeled axes apply uniformly to all plotted points and the nearby week text labels identify those points.
